title.narrative: UNICEF made strategic progress in embedding child rights into governance, planning, and public finance systems. Through policy dialogues, subnational engagement, and evidence generation, UNICEF fostered cross-sector alignment and institutional advocacy. Key achievements include education budget analysis, proposals for a universal child grant, and operationalization of data systems like ITHAA'. These efforts collectively strengthened inclusive planning and positioned child-sensitive approaches at the core of national development.
